request.text:
<low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: sad.> Things went downstream after the fight. The river's carried worse. Not much worse.
<long pause>
<low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: happy.> Goblin children fish the far bank now. Taught one to tie a net. Don't tell the captain.
<long pause>
<low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: idle.> River's stopped steaming at the docks. First time since I was a boy. Feels like a held breath.
